summary: Explains why the Stringprep approach, used by IDNA2003 and several protocol profiles, needs revision, and states the problem for a new framework called PRECIS for preparing and comparing internationalized strings. It is a problem statement, and it is informational.

eli5.summary: Computers must tell whether two names are the same even when written with fancy letters. This explains why the old way of cleaning up names fell short and what a new way must do.
